basis: The live pricing-feed row anchored on https://kie.ai/gpt-image-2-6?model=gpt-image-2-6%2Feconomy-image-to-image and the live GET /api/v1/models pricingDesc agree: a flat 5 credits (0.025 USD) per 1K image, the channel's only size, with no charge per input image. png is the only output format. Both reads match the 2026-11-12 survey. The docs callback example's creditsConsumed of 3 is a template: its task id repeats on the gpt-image-2 and 2.5 Sunburst and Flare image-to-image pages and its createTime predates this model. The recording below billed 5 at submission. It sends the smallest body text-to-image proved (prompt plus aspect_ratio) with one input image, because a text-to-image task without aspect_ratio fails upstream with failCode 500.

entry.title: GPT Image 2.6 (Economy) Image to Image
entry.pricingDesc: GPT Image 2.6 (Economy) — just 5 credits ($0.025) per 1K image. Same GPT Image 2.6 model, served through our economy channel at a flat per-image price, 1K only. High-tier top-ups (+10% bonus) bring effective pricing down to ~10% off the above rates.
